name: csv-lambda
description: CSV input processing on AWS Lambda (Serverless Framework v4 + Python 3.14)

scripts.invoke:s3: python -m poetry run python scripts/invoke_local.py s3
scripts.invoke:api: python -m poetry run python scripts/invoke_local.py api
scripts.lint: python -m poetry run ruff check src tests scripts && python -m poetry run black --check src tests scripts
scripts.format: python -m poetry run ruff check --fix src tests scripts && python -m poetry run black src tests scripts
scripts.check-all: yarn lint && yarn typecheck && yarn test
